MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "If Forte is the vocal trio album, its classical crossover singing feels like a natural next choice after A Musical Affair and Lead With Your Heart.",
    "Love Somebody connects with my interest in 747 and Golden, although that side of my listening is less appealing than soothing classical crossover today."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "That's Christmas To Me and PTXmas connect with my Christmas listening, but that interest depends on the occasion; I want relaxing everyday music now.",
    "25, Storyteller and How Can It Be do not give me a strong reason to expect the gentle vocals or orchestral sound I currently want.",
    "New Moves / Traces, Heritage and A Wonderful World leave me uncertain about their musical fit; an appealing title alone is not enough for me to choose them."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My past Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing preference regardless of what I want on this occasion.",
    "My interest in a few country albums seems to have been extended too broadly when I am currently more interested in relaxing classical and vocal music."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest interaction with The Most Relaxing Classical Music in the Universe is a useful clue that calm, soothing listening matters to me now.",
    "The connection among my vocal crossover albums is the expressive singing and melodic accompaniment; other vocal albums do not automatically offer that same experience."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The choices recognize parts of my vocal and country listening history but give too little weight to my current preference for soothing classical crossover."
}
